meta_description:
927 likes, 18 comments - tech_shuffle on September 22, 2026: "Biggest Aadhaar App Update is Live - UIDAI New Aadhaar App 2025 is here with all new features

The new UIDAI Aadhaar App update is finally here and this is the biggest update ever. After you download the app and complete authentication, everything is now in one place.

On the home screen you can view your Aadhaar Card front, back and QR code in a single tab. You can also download your Aadhaar Card in one click directly from the app. And the most important feature, biometric lock and unlock, you can now lock or unlock your biometrics in a single click.

If you go to the services tab, you can update your mobile number online for just 75 rupees and the processing time is also mentioned there. Similarly you can update your address online by paying 75 rupees. You can also check your Aadhaar authentication history to see where your Aadhaar card has been used.

The coolest feature of this new Aadhaar App is selective Aadhaar sharing. If you want to share only selected details like name, age or Aadhaar number, you can select and share only that. You can also add your family members Aadhaar by creating different profiles in the same app. And we tested it, this new Aadhaar App works without internet as well.

Save this video and share it with your family groups before you miss this update.".
